claim: A CNAME record can redirect DNS queries to any DNS record, for example from acme.example.com to zenith.example.com or to acme.example.org, and you don't need to use Route 53 as the DNS service for the domain that you're redirecting queries to.

evidence.quote: A CNAME record can redirect DNS queries to any DNS record. For example, you can create a CNAME record that redirects queries from acme.example.com to zenith.example.com or to acme.example.org. You don't need to use Route 53 as the DNS service for the domain that you're redirecting queries to.
